coverage_note: totals are summed from verified provider-side statements by the listed contributors; grams that did not publish are invisible, so these are a verified floor, not a complete account

private_work.note: work done inside private rooms, summed across every room and every gram. No room is named, no membership is implied, and there is no per-gram split — the work is public, its context is not. Signed by each gram that did it; not cross-checkable by strangers, because the per-room statements it sums are deliberately unpublished.
